backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor that handles user profiles, event registrations (workshop/competition/seminar), and admin-only stats/queries, using access control mixins and blob storage for authorization and file handling.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms the old actor state (dropping sessionTokens) into the new RegistrationState shape for continuous data persistence.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (registration submission flow, admin login, admin dashboard) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'ELECTROSPARKS' that mounts the React app at the `#root` div and loads the main TSX entry point as an ES module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that manages the phoenix intro sequence, sets up TanStack Router with all page routes (including hidden `/admin`), and wraps the app in QueryClientProvider and RegistrationProvider.
frontend/src/components/AdminDashboard.t: Admin dashboard component displaying stat cards (total registrations, participants, revenue) and a filterable, sortable registrations table with CSV export, screenshot preview modal, and refresh/logout controls.
frontend/src/components/CircuitPattern.t: Renders a decorative SVG circuit board pattern as an absolutely positioned background overlay with configurable opacity using orange-toned lines, IC chip shapes, and dots.
frontend/src/components/CountdownTimer.t: Displays a live countdown timer to a fixed deadline of March 10, 2026, updating every second and showing days, hours, minutes, and seconds with an orange glowing UI style.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a site footer with a three-column layout containing brand info, quick navigation links, and contact details for the VibECX-2K26 ECE department event.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Displays an animated loading screen with a canvas-drawn waveform, a progress bar, and cycling status messages, calling onComplete after approximately 3 seconds.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with the VibECX-2K26 brand, desktop nav links with active-state highlighting, scroll-based background change, and a responsive mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/PhoenixIntro.tsx: Full-screen cinematic intro overlay featuring a phoenix image, animated ember particle canvas effect, and a radial glow pulse, fading out and calling onComplete after ~7 seconds.
frontend/src/contexts/RegistrationContex: Defines a React context for storing and managing event registration form data, exposing set and clear functions via a custom `useRegistration` hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity or anonymously, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` and `useInternetIdentity` hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout state, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for submitting registrations, client-side admin login validation, fetching admin stats, and fetching all registrations from the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Orbitron/Rajdhani/Share Tech Mono fonts and defining a dark neon-cyan design system with Tailwind base layers, CSS custom properties, and utility classes for neon glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin login page that validates hardcoded credentials client-side and renders the `AdminDashboard` component upon successful authentication, with a logout handler.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying staff and student coordinator details with a dark neon-orange glass-card UI, ambient glow blobs, and a circuit background pattern.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page for VibECX-2K26 symposium featuring an animated hero section with event stats (prize pool, colleges, participants, events), a circuit pattern background, and navigation to registration.
frontend/src/pages/NonTechnicalEvents.ts: Displays a grid of five non-technical events (AD-MAD, JAM, Dump Charades, Talent Show, E-Sports) with icons, descriptions, and hover effects on a dark themed layout.
frontend/src/pages/Payment.tsx: Payment page where users upload a payment screenshot (drag-and-drop or file picker), reads the registration amount from localStorage, and submits the registration to the backend before navigating to a success page.
frontend/src/pages/Register.tsx: Registration form page that collects participant details, calculates fees based on event type and member count, saves data to localStorage and the backend actor, then navigates to the Payment page.
frontend/src/pages/Schedule.tsx: Event schedule page listing 15 timed sessions with venue and description, supporting filter tabs (all, technical, non-technical, general) with color-coded event type badges.
frontend/src/pages/Success.tsx: Displays a styled registration success page with a confirmation message, event info, and a home navigation button after a successful VibECX-2K26 registration submission.
frontend/src/pages/TechnicalEvents.tsx: Renders a grid of five technical events (Paper Presentation, PCB Design, Technical Crosscode, Tech Talk, Quiz Master) with icons and descriptions for the VibECX-2K26 symposium.
frontend/src/utils/csvExport.ts: Provides a utility to export an array of Registration records to a downloadable CSV file, with helpers for formatting timestamps and event types.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, neon color palette, box shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations, plus plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's architectural notes, implemented features, and known issues for the VibECX-2K26 event registration site with admin dashboard, serving as a build-planning state document.
